notes:
Inbound SMB lead via self-serve signup and trial credits. Team: CTO (Aaron Lee), Eng Lead (Maya), product manager.

Timeline:
- 2026-02-18: self-serve signup, small test app deployed (chat + embeddings).
- 2026-02-25: follow-up email (trial usage ~12k tokens).
- 2026-03-02: discovery call (Fireflies ff_20260302_call_8921). Carlos ran demo; CTO asked detailed perf/cost questions.
- 2026-03-05: POC started (embedding index + support chat). Early runs show Mistral variant is cheapest but higher rate of hallucination on product spec queries. Llama-2-13b had better factuality but cost ~1.6x. Qwen-7b appears responsive on short prompts with lower memory but uncertain on edge-cases.

Customer comments / needs:
- "We need the cheapest option that doesn't hallucinate on product specs — hallucinations are fatal for support use-case." (Aaron, CTO)
- Strong cost sensitivity: SMB budget, will scale if unit economics work.
- Wants recommended model choices for hosted API (tradeoffs: Llama vs Mistral vs Qwen), and clear quantization / multi-variant routing guidance.
- Preference for public cloud hosting (no VPC/on-prem yet). SOC2 required for integrations with support systems.

Technical constraints:
- Latency target ~200-500ms p95 for chat flows.
- Throughput expected 10-25 rps peak.
- Small memory footprint on prototype (single small node).

POC results / observations:
- Mistral-large: lowest cost per token, good for short generative responses, occasional hallucination on product spec retrieval tasks.
- Llama-2-13b: strongest factuality on product specs, higher cost and slightly higher latency in our test.
- Qwen-7b: fast on short interactions, smaller model size helps in prototype, mixed factuality on long-form.

Open questions asked by customer:
- How much improvement can Redwood hosted API provide via quantized model variants? Any recommended quantization levels for Llama/Mistral/Qwen?
- Can Redwood do automated routing: prefer Llama for knowledge-heavy prompts, fallback to Mistral for shorter chat to save cost? How to configure?
- Billing caps and wallet/top-up model for SMBs? Need clarity on overruns.

Next steps agreed:
- Redwood to send short one-pager: model quality vs cost comparison (run-times, token cost estimates, recommended quantization).
- Prepare a sample routing policy config (canary policy + fallback rules).
- Schedule 30m follow-up demo for billing/quotas + SE deep-dive (proposed week of 2026-03-15).
